text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 2, 2025) for 11 Bergamot Avenue, 201.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 2, 2025) for 11 Bergamot Avenue, 201, Folder Number 25 167847 PRS 00 IV, and granted an extension of time to December 1, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
